reviews.text: HAd to take my young puppy here last week in rather unfortunate circumstances, I was helped by Vet Jenny and her assistant whos name I didnt catch unfortuanetly but just wanted to note here how helpful they were and I apreeciate the efforts the went to to try and help out

Ended up here as emergency vets on a Sunday and had a far from satisfactory experience. Dog came home in a worse situation than when he went in, and later telephone calls that evening were not returned as promised. He ended up on an IV drip at another vets the next morning for two days.  I won't trust my pets' lives here in future!
Hannah the exotic pet vet was extremely supportive with spitfire our suger glider and myself.

Christina dealt with us during the most traumatic end of life experience with our cat and she made us feel safe and valued. She let us stay throughout and talked us through every stage. She helped baby pass with as much pride and dignity as she could give her. She is a very special type of vet and if you are lucky enough to be seen by her, your Animal will be in the best possible care I could ever have dreamt of or wished for. Thank you very much, Holly house vets.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Holly House Vets following the critical illness and eventual death of my 26-year-old red-eared slider turtle on 26 August 2026.
My turtle had been a patient at Holly House for more than 10 years, and until this experience I had been satisfied with the service I received. The last time she was seen there was in 2022.
At the beginning of August, however, my turtle became critically ill and urgently needed veterinary attention. Over the weekend, I contacted Holly House's out-of-hours service because I was extremely worried and needed emergency help for my reptile. I was told that there was no vet available who could help because they were not experienced with exotic animals. I was instead advised to contact other veterinary practices, including those outside my local area, to find somebody with exotic experience.
As a very worried owner, I found this extremely distressing. I had specifically contacted Holly House because they advertise exotic pet care, and my turtle had been a long-standing patient there.
Thankfully, I eventually found another vet who was willing to see my turtle despite not being an exotic specialist. He did his very best to help her and advised me to contact Holly House again on the next working day because they had medication suitable for reptiles that my turtle need.
When I contacted Holly House on the Monday and explained the situation, I asked for an urgent appointment. During the conversation, I was repeatedly corrected when I referred to an exotic specialist. I was told that Holly House had vets with exotic certification and that they were not specialists. I understand that there is a distinction between being an exotic-certified vet and being a specialist, but my concern was not about terminology — I desperately needed appropriate veterinary care for a critically ill reptile.
I was then offered an appointment on 2 September with an exotic-certified vet. I explained that this was far too late given how seriously ill my turtle was. Sadly, my fears became reality: my precious turtle died on 26 August, before the appointment date.
What has upset me most is that, when Holly House could not provide the emergency care my turtle needed, I was not given meaningful assistance in finding an alternative veterinary service that could treat her urgently. I had to search around myself while dealing with an extremely sick animal.
I appreciate that no veterinary practice can guarantee that an appropriate vet will always be available, and I am not blaming Holly House for the fact that my turtle ultimately died. What I am deeply disappointed by is the lack of urgent support and guidance when I contacted a practice that presents itself as being able to provide care for exotic pets.
My turtle was with me for 26 years, so losing her has been devastating. I will always be grateful to the vet who agreed to see her that weekend and tried his very best to help, despite not having specialist reptile experience.
This experience has completely changed my confidence in relying on Holly House Vets for emergency care on any care for reptiles. I sincerely hope the practice reviews how it supports owners with exotic pets who contact them for urgent or general help.
Thank you
Great fast service 👏 …
This vets was taken over and hasn’t been the same since sadly. The online booking system doesn’t work, the phones are never answered and it’s impossible to get an appointment.

Super experience with an out of hours appointment for a cockatoo. Staff were very lovely and apologized for the small wait time - which was completely understandable since there were other emergency appointments given it was out of hours. The vet Yasmin was very kind and patient with him and was able to give advice and start the set up for other services during call hours in the week, along with some medicine now to help him feel better. We were given a clear understanding of what possibilities there were for next steps and it was a very lovely appointment all round.

I tried calling the vets multiple times but nobody answered the phone. Each time i called I was waiting for 20/30 minutes for someone to answer but each time there was no answer. This was at 5/6pm which is during opening time. My cat is normally registered with beechwood vets and when I called it mentioned Holly House vets is the emergency out of hours service. I was then transferred to this line. Ive seen quite a few more reviews having issues with contacting the vets out of hours.

Holly House got my 12 week tiny puppy in for an appointment in 20 mins ,puppy had a reaction to a vacination which she had from another surgery day before. I was extremely happy they treated my puppy so quickly .

We took our cockeral Freddie to see the vet, he was very unwell. The vet and staff were fantastic, the treatment he reviewed was brilliant and he is getting back to being his very cheeky, lively self. We cannot thank Hollyhouse vets enough for their support at what has been a very stressful and upsetting time xx

I was previously at a different vets and I wasnt happy with the treatment me or My Fudge were receiving. It seemed like they just wanted to fob me off with different medicines and my cat was becoming increasingly weak. I decided to move over to Holly House. From the start we were made to feel so welcome, from the receptionists to the vet nurses and more importantly, I felt like they had a plan in mind for Fudge without the unnecessary back and fourth with no answers. They explain everything so well with different options and recommendations and dont put any pressure on you at all. They are always super busy but they always make time for you and I wasnt waiting long and there is coffee and tea to help yourself while you wait. The receptionist on my last visit was coming back from her lunch and she helped me put Fudge into my car and was just so lovely to us both. Thank you to everyone at Holly House!
Rach and Fudge 🐾
Thank you for 5 stars please share why you have us this

We took our guinea pig here during emergency hours, they took him in. After about two minutes the nurse walked up to us and said with a smile on her face “I’m sorry, he’s just had a seizure and passed away”. She didn’t even give us a minute to let it sink in before asking us to pay. I don’t know if they could do anything about my guinea pig, but they sure as hell could have some empathy right after telling us he died. And of course we had to pay the full price of the emergency rate. Do not take your pet here

Our beloved dog became ill over the weekend, our vet practices were closed I was directed to Holly House as the emergency on call  practice. I was apprehensive as this wasn’t the practice we were comfortable in. I need not have worried from my first phone call I was put as ease. Jasmine the vet who we saw showed our pet and ourselves kindness, compassion, she was sensitive to all our needs. Unfortunately Willow went over the rainbow bridge, the 2 nurses that supported Jasmin were fabulous. The whole team paid attention to each detail I told them about Willow from him not liking his front paws touching to not liking the examination table. Nothing was too much trouble. A big heart felt thank you to all involved
The Arnell family x

Travelled from Rotherham to see a lovely vet called Tom with our very poorly snake. From our initial enquiry with the reception team to ultimately having to make a difficult decision for our pet the team here were kind, professional and we could really tell that they cared. Although we had to say goodbye to our girl, we were given clear options from Tom who we could tell was experienced and cared. We were then allowed time to process and decide with no pressure. Thank you to the team working today - you made a difficult situation a lot more pleasant with the service you provided us.
Thank you for your 5 star review- please feel free to tell us why you gave us this rating

I had concerns about my panther chameleon's stool and weight loss and booked in to be seen by Tom.

Tom is extremely knowledgeable and prescribed medicine for my chameleon and showed how to administer it myself when he is next due it. He was considerate handling my chameleon and explained everything in thorough detail.

Beverly on the reception is a ray of sunshine. She is so cheerful and it really helps to put a brighter mood on a vet visit which can often be quite worrying. She treat myself and my girlfriend with such a kind tone and everyone else who entered the practice the same.

I was worried an exotic vet would be very expensive, especially a 24hr emergency practice, but everything was reasonable and we were out the door with medicine in an hour since our appointment time. Spot on service.
Brilliant 24 hour emergency vetanary practice
Thank you for your 5 star rating
Thank you for your rating, please tell us more about why you gave us a three star

I have been attending Holly House Vets since 2022 with my chickens, and I genuinely cannot recommend them highly enough. From the very beginning, every member of the team has shown exceptional care, kindness, and compassion towards my animals.

Over the years, they have treated and helped recover both my rooster and my hens on multiple occasions, always providing outstanding veterinary care and support. They understand how much my birds mean to me and have always treated them with the same level of attention and dedication that they would any beloved pet.

A special mention has to go to Tom, who is an absolutely fantastic vet. He is knowledgeable, compassionate, reassuring, and always takes the time to explain everything thoroughly. His care and commitment have made such a difference, especially during stressful times when my chickens have been unwell.

The practice has always done its best to provide appointments when needed, and I have never felt rushed or unsupported. Their professionalism, expertise, and genuine love for animals shine through in everything they do.

I wouldn’t trust my chickens with anyone else. Holly House Vets are worth every penny, and I am truly grateful for everything they have done for my flock over the years. Thank you all for your continued care, dedication, and compassion.

Been today and arrived 5 mins before my appointment. There was only appointment ahead of mine. Receptionist took my pets name and said to take a seat. 45 minutes later and still waiting another member if staff came out and my daughter asked of it was gonna be much longer and then a few minutes later we got called in. I suspect the Receptionist that took our name has forgot to say we were waiting. We were there for on one and half hours in total which I feel is totally unacceptable especially when your the only person in the waiting room. The vet that we saw was lovely but in my opinion we had a very long unnecessary wait and a long journey home in bad traffic

My mum had an appointment at 3pm. I took time out of work to take her as she was worried and felt lucky to get an appointment at short notice. We arrived just before 3pm, checked in as normal. 3pm came and went. At 3:20 I asked the receptionist if it would be much longer, to be told “she” presumably the vet was with the people before us. Understandably appointments run over but we didn’t get seen until 3:40 and the previous people had come out of their appointment a bit before that. There was then no one on the desk and we had to look through the window of the door to the back to try and get someone’s attention to be asked “are you ok there”… I replied well the appointment was almost 45 minutes ago. She got the vet and we were then seen. The vet was really nice but then disappeared for a long time to speak to an exotic vet on the phone. Frustrating as we thought we were seeing an exotic vet. Just felt like a really long drawn out process and seemed a little like they didn’t care which is really sad. They had someone sat in the waiting room worried about her pet while they basically forgot about us, or that’s how it felt anyway.
Called yesterday in regards to my parrot. Called the emergency one and was told to "call your normal vet". I lost my parrot last night.
They was very understanding and polite and friendly, helpful

If you have an exotic pet such as an Axolotl and cannot see Tom then AVOID..!!
Just spent essentially two hours with my daughter transporting our very ill axolotl there only to be seen by a junior cat and dog vet (not as told in the phone) who didn’t know anything about axolotls and had to relay everything to the ‘exotic vet’ who was upstairs and in other rooms but couldn’t be bothered to come in and asses or discuss herself.! Have gone round and round discussing antibios that had previously worked on another specimen the ‘exotic vet’ then backtracked to tubbing..! A basic DIY treatment suggested over Facebook but not for something so advanced that the film on the body is coming off leaving it gasping for air! A wasted ‘emergency’ journey the cost two hours and £50 leaving us with a still very poorly Axolotl! An absolute joke of poor service by people that should know better!! Disgraceful!

Very good, treated my kitten very nicely and really happy with the service 😄

Very lovely - unfortunately my kitten died a year later - I was treated with so much respect and was given so much time to say goodbye to my baby! I will forever be greatful for these vets! And will keep using them going forward! Thank you so much
Thank you. We would love to hear why you gave us a 5 star review

They were supposed to be on call today as it was bank holiday. Multiple calls from other vet practices were being redirected to them for emergencies but they do not answer the phone. We were ringing all day today, the woman who answers the phone was mumbling something in her mouth, so low so we could not hear her. When we were asking to speak a bit louder so we can communicate she would hang up on us. Multiple calls all the same. We rang many times try to book in an appointment,  every time the same issue. They would hand up on us and never called back. Going through the automated message all nice and clear and then this woman answers the phone talking in such low voice to make it impossible to hear what she was saying and then would hang up on us. Thankfully we got to see another lovely vets in Bradford who were very friendly and saw us almost immediately.
If you do not want calls after hours, do not advertise it.

⸻

Losing my dog was devastating. What made it even more painful was the way communication was handled throughout my experience.

When I first called because my dog had collapsed, I was told they were dealing with another emergency and to call back in ten minutes. At that moment, it was truly a life-or-death situation. Pet owners need immediate guidance, reassurance, or clear triage direction in emergencies. Being asked to simply call back left me feeling unsupported during the most critical moment. Tragically, my dog was put to sleep due to a splenic bleed — a situation the vets could not have changed.

Afterwards, when I raised concerns, I was advised there was a 14-day timeframe in relation to my complaint. This was later described as a misunderstanding. I understand that miscommunications can happen; however, clarity and consistency are especially important when someone is grieving and seeking answers. The shifting explanation added confusion and unnecessary stress at an already traumatic time.

Rather than clear accountability, responses often felt focused on process rather than acknowledging the emotional impact of the situation. Clients should not have to repeatedly push for clarity when raising legitimate concerns.

While reports were eventually provided, the overall handling of communication added avoidable distress during an already heartbreaking experience.

I hope Holly House reflects seriously on how communication, triage procedures, ownership, and empathy are delivered in situations where pets’ lives are at stake

Such love and care for animals.
Our dog needed overnight emergency care , and that care was exceptional not just to our dog but to us too.
Everyone there was caring and respectful and explained everything to us including the financial side of things.

I hope we never need there service again, but would definitely recommend

I would like to express my deepest gratitude for the care and compassion you showed our cat, Tank on 24th Nov 2025

Dr Amy explained all of the options clearly and answered every one of our questions with patience and understanding. Although it was an extremely difficult moment for our family, her calm guidance helped us make the kindest decision for Tank.

When it was time to say goodbye, Dr Amy and the team there made sure we had the space, privacy, and time we needed. The arrangements she provided allowed us to sit with Tank, talk to him, and spend our final moments together in the most peaceful way possible. We are truly thankful for that.

Obviously they help and care for animals but prices are astronomical, insurance were shocked at the prices and refused to pay out the full amount because there charges were predatory. Would not recommend this vet at all. Wolf in sheep's clothing.

Thank you so much for helping me through my baby's last moments. You were right, it was awful but it was the right thing to do, and thank you for letting her have a snack and cuddles first and say goodbye to my other pet, and being so supportive to me.
Had to take my stepdaughter's ferret to be checked as he was limping and Tom the vet was brilliant he explained everything and let us ask any questions we had. Reception staff was lovely and helpful.
Friendly and professional.

We normally attend White Cross vets, who are excellent. They refer to Holly House for emergencies. We rang early Saturday evening as our dog had something stuck in his teeth/mouth. We’re advised to keep trying to get it out and send a video if necessary. We rang Abbey House in Morley and were told to go in straight away. Kylo had to be sedated to remove some red material that was stuck between his teeth and wound round his tongue. He has now fully recovered. Holly House should have asked us to go in - but they didn’t see it as an emergency.
I brought my cat to see them as I was worried that he was unwell and was going to die, they looked at him and said that he was unwell and was going to die.

I found myself having to use their emergency service in the most distressing circumstances!? They were AMAZING. Extremely fast, caring (to my cat and me), considerate, and totally transparent with everything (potential cost/s, outcome, and afterlife care) My husband called them to make arrangements and to pay but they did not push or request immediate payment. Thank you for your honesty, understanding, and compassion
Incredibly helpful, speedy and thorough!

We took our cat through the night when she suddenly became ill. The vet was very sympathetic and caring. Offered to take paw prints and clipping. They looked after her until the crematorium could collect her. Would use again.
Best experience I’ve had at a vets, really friendly, informative and professional.
Great when we had to take our sick cat to the vet. It was expensive but it's the amount of money you have to pay for your cat to be seen same day.

We had to call Holly House when we were overseas because our elderly cat was showing possible signs / symptoms of pancreatitis and I was very worried. Holly House are the emergency vet for our usual vet and I haven’t needed to contact them before.

Melanie, who took the call was just so unbelievably kind, warm, helpful and took time to listen (as I was fairly neurotic!) talked me through options and liaised with the vet to provide some feedback and what to look out for - she also followed up with an email with details and what to do if our pet sitter needed to bring our cat in. I was just so impressed - thank you!

I can’t comment on treatment which is a good thing for me - but if the customer service is anything to go by this is a great place! 😊

AVOID HOLLY HOUSE VET AT ALL COSTS – MONEY COMES BEFORE YOUR PET’S LIFE

I’m writing this review as a devastated and furious pet owner who deeply regrets ever trusting Holly House Vets. If you value your pet’s life and well-being, do not go there.

My cat was perfectly healthy and playful before we brought her in for a simple vaccination. That’s when everything started going downhill.

After the vaccination, the vet insisted we purchase a combined flea and worm treatment which we trusted was safe. However, we later received a call from the same vet admitting she had prescribed the wrong medication for our cat. This wasn’t a minor error giving the wrong treatment can seriously harm an animal. We were so concerned by the mistake that we asked her to confirm it in writing, and she did. I have the email as proof of her negligence.

Following the visit, my cat’s behaviour changed she became less active. A few weeks later, she came back from outdoors with a limp tail and stopped pooing for several days. We went back to Holly House for help, hoping they’d take real action. Instead, they told us we either had to put her to sleep or take her home and we asked what if she still not pooing they said give as a call; that’s it no tests, no scan, no explanation and they charged us over £100 just to say that.

We asked whether she needed an X-ray or any further checks, and they completely dismissed it. Thankfully, we got a second opinion elsewhere, and another vet gave us affordable treatment. Within hours, she finally passed stool and started feeling better.

Unfortunately, that wasn’t the end.

She wasn’t eating for a few days and I was really worried, so yesterday I took her to the Holly House emergency hospital. The first thing they did was confirm I was ready to pay £180, before even seeing my cat. I said yes because money meant nothing compared to saving her. The vet barely examined her and immediately gave us two cold, extreme options: either pay £1500 just for diagnostic tests (with no treatment included) or put her to sleep. No real diagnosis, no real effort and on top of that, they pressured me to make a decision quickly, saying they needed the room for further emergencies. I was completely shocked. That £180? It was just to be rushed into a life or death decision, with no proper care

Once again, we walked away and took her to another vet, where she was treated with real care, for a much lower cost, and with genuine empathy and professionalism.

This place is heartless. Holly House Vets care more about how much they can charge you than they do about your animal’s life. They were ready to euthanise my cat without even understanding what was wrong. That’s beyond negligent it’s cruel.

I will never go back to this clinic, and I urge anyone reading this to take their pet anywhere else. You deserve compassion, proper care, and a vet that puts animals before profit. Holly House failed us completely.

Fantastic team at Holly House, reassuring, professional and warm.
Cannot fault them and a much needed emergency service.
Excellent vets. Really care about the animals they treat and the owners of the pets.

Prices are way out of the normal range, all they are interested in is making profit from your sick pet! £50 for a DOSE of metacam whilst in the vets, when a full prescription bottle is around £30..  along with all the other charges for single doses of medication.
Emergency visit, very impressed with the efficiency and professionalism of the Holly House team.  I felt my pet had the best care, fast, effective and accurate.
Really helpful team! Found a lost dog and they quickly tracked down the owners.

After waking up to find my 23 year old African Grey very weak and in respiratory distress I rang round trying to find an emergency avian vet appointment. After being advised he needed to go into hospital we made the trip to Holly House. Everybody was amazing, explaining everything, keeping us informed about his progress and the cost at all times. I was happy he was in good hands. He made a rapid recovery and I would like to thank everyone for taking care of him.
Incredible service and very helpful. Huge thanks for Francisco for your guidance and support during our difficult time.

We had to take our cat, Nectar, to Holly House out of hours, and the care we received was exceptional. The team was professional, compassionate, and incredibly thorough, which made such a stressful situation a little easier to handle.

They explained everything clearly and treated Nectar with such kindness and respect. It’s reassuring to know that such great care is available when you need it most.

I’d highly recommend Holly House for anyone needing out-of-hours vet services. Thank you to the team for everything you did for us and for Nectar!

I am sorry that the lives of animals are worthless to them. My cat's hand was injured at home. I took him there quickly and they gave me a form that I signed for three hundred and fifty pounds and I was happy that they were helping my cat..! The next morning they sent me an invoice for 750 pounds and if you don't take the cat, it will be more than that!!!!!!!! My cat was not treated, why!!!!! They didn't even bandage his hand!!!! and they just asked for money!! I spent a week in a hotel and didn't spend that much money, what did you do for him and now I have to go somewhere else and get a scan! This is daylight robbery and I really feel sorry for this company😡😡
Such an amazing lovely vets with such empathetic staff they were so lovely when our baby skye passed away would 100% recommend x

The staff do an amazing job, I took a Woodcock in that flaw into the side of a building, sadly the bird didn't make it due to it's injury, but the staff we're amazing and do an amazing job looking after animals, thank you

We recently took my mum’s beloved cat to Holly House Vets, and we are so grateful for the kindness and compassion they showed us. The team was gentle, understanding, and treated our cat with such care and respect. They created a calm and peaceful environment, ensuring her final moments were handled with dignity and love. Thank you for your incredible support and thoughtfulness—it truly meant so much my mum. You have an incredible team!

Don't get me wrong, my dog loves the vets, and they are really good. 99% of the staff are truly amazing, but the cost is problematic.

£60 for a consultation is fine, but then the final bill includes £40 for 'extra consultation' and a staggering £90 to bandage.

If you look deeper into the company that owns Holly House, it's owned by a company that clearly just wants to rinse pet owners....
I expect all vet practices are the same - but £60 for a ten minute consultation is unnecessary.

Just to say how caring and compassionate the whole staff were towards my friend Sarah and her cat Bella. Sadly Bellas time had come but the lovely attitude of the staff couldn't have been better and this softened the blow. Thanks from Sarah's friends. X
Horrendous experience of the last few months. I'm utterly disgusted in the negligent treatment received and the response from management in this regard.
Not our usual vets, but we required their help as an emergency out of hours. At a very sad and distressing time, all the staff were so caring and compassionate.
